"""Cloud compute VM lifecycle state machine and schemas."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import List, Tuple, Any, Dict, Set
from errors import ServiceError

@dataclass
class VirtualMachine:
    entity_id: str
    state: str = "PROVISIONING"
    audit_trail: List[Tuple[Any, ...]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def is_active(self) -> bool:
        return self.state == "RUNNING"

VM_TRANSITIONS: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {
    "PROVISIONING": {"RUNNING", "TERMINATED"},
    "RUNNING": {"STOPPED", "TERMINATED"},
    "STOPPED": {"RUNNING", "TERMINATED"},
    "TERMINATED": set(),
}

def apply_vm_transition(vm: VirtualMachine, target_state: str, actor_id: str, timestamp_ms: int) -> None:
    """Validates and applies compute lifecycle update."""
    cur = vm.state
    allowed = VM_TRANSITIONS.get(cur, set())
    if target_state not in allowed:
        # Fixed: Use standard error code and add audit trail entry
        raise ServiceError(code="ERR_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION", message="Invalid state transition")
    vm.state = target_state
    # Add audit trail entry for the transition
    vm.audit_trail.append((cur, target_state, actor_id, timestamp_ms))
=== END ===
=== FILE: tests/test_instance_cases.py ===
import pytest
from instance_fsm import VirtualMachine
from instance_controller import update_instance_state

def test_case_1():
    vm = VirtualMachine("vm-01")
    # Test that a valid transition works
    update_instance_state(vm, "RUNNING", "system", 1700000000000)
    assert vm.state == "RUNNING"
    # Test that an invalid transition raises the correct error
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        update_instance_state(vm, "PROVISIONING", "system", 1700000000001)
    assert "ERR_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION" in str(exc_info.value)
    # Verify audit trail was updated
    assert len(vm.audit_trail) == 1
    assert vm.audit_trail[0][0] == "PROVISIONING"
    assert vm.audit_trail[0][1] == "RUNNING"
    assert vm.audit_trail[0][2] == "system"
    assert vm.audit_trail[0][3] == 1700000000000
=== END ===
